PRE FIRED (a monotone step Z_in=0 gains a spurious extremum Z_out=1 on all three TVD limiters; inflow boundary cell collapses to 1.474e-38) / POST HELD (Z_out=0, boundary cell 1.0). Re-run is bit-identical (deterministic). THE BUG MECHANISM: ql,qr (left/right reconstructed interface states) are Fortran intent(out) assigned ONLY inside the difference/limiter loop (qr(m,i)=q(m,i)+0.5*qlimitr*dqm ; ql(m,i)=q(m,i)-0.5*qlimitr*dqm); the pre-fix bounds skip the boundary-adjacent cell, leaving its reconstruction uninitialised, which with num_ghost=2 feeds the physical update and corrupts the boundary cell, breaking the no-spurious-extrema (TVD-monotonicity) invariant. THIS IS FAMILY g (D*), NOT family f: the violation is the DYNAMIC shape of the evolved trace (Z(Phi x) > Z(x) on a monotone input), the classic TVD-limiter no-oscillation guarantee, in a genuine hyperbolic finite-volume substrate -- the substrate the scipy NEGATIVE_scipy_dstar.md documented as ABSENT in SciPy.

The defect bites at num_ghost=2 (the historical tvd2 ghost count and a supported setting); with the modern default num_ghost=3 the skipped cell falls strictly inside the ghost halo and the bug is masked.
